card.text: Sponge-like moon of Saturn that tumbles chaotically as it orbits.

introduction.text: Hyperion is a porous, potato-shaped moon. Its darkest, reddest areas are the floors of its deep craters.

normal.title: ISS calibrated mosaic
normal.summary: Twelve Cassini frames, including a close regional view at about 100 m per pixel; shadows remain.

filter-color.title: Cassini false color
filter-color.summary: Measured filter bands in false color, not human-visible color. Photographed shadows remain.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 135 km sphere; the shape may be off by up to 6 km on the less-seen side.
